Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the independent variable by incorrectly interpreting the experimental setup. It claimed the "amount of fertilizer" was varied, whereas the text explicitly states "Add the same amount of different brands of fertilizer," meaning the amount is constant and the brand (type) is the variable being changed. This is a fundamental error in distinguishing between the manipulated factor (type of fertilizer) and the controlled factor (amount of fertilizer).
